title: Prefixes
note: Rewrite 2026-08-30 from Spec_Prefixes_B1_V_WFM. Core 8: un- dis- in-(im-/il-/ir-) re- pre- over- under- mis-. Match = prefix→meaning+examples. Quiz 12 · Type 12 · Use 12 error-correction (wrong prefix). Exam Practice still pools the gap items.

cards.title: Prefixes
points: A prefix goes **before** the root and changes the **meaning**.
A suffix goes **after** the root and changes the **word class**.

cards.title: One root, many meanings
points: The prefix changes what it means.

cards.title: Not / the opposite: un- and dis-
points: With verbs, **un**- and **dis**- reverse the action: lock → **unlock**.

cards.title: The in- family
cards.diagram_fallback: m/p/b → im- · l → il- · r → ir- · else → in-
points: Czech **ne-** covers all of these — English chooses by the root.

items.en: He unlocked the door.
She disagreed with the plan.
Parking is illegal on this street.
You have to rewrite the report.
Preheat the oven first.
I overslept this morning.
The chicken was undercooked.
I think you misunderstood me.
I overslept this morning and missed the train.
items.gap: I ____ this morning and missed the train.
items.explanation: You slept too much and missed the train: **over** + sleep → **overslept**.
items.explanation_cz: Spal jsi moc dlouho a vlak ujel: **over** + sleep → **overslept**.

items.en: There are too many mistakes — you will have to rewrite the report.
items.gap: There are too many mistakes — you'll have to ____ the report.
items.explanation: Too many mistakes → do it again: **re**write. **Overwrite** means write on top.
items.explanation_cz: Příliš chyb → znovu: **re**write. **Overwrite** je napsat přes to.

items.en: I think you misunderstood me — I said Tuesday, not Thursday.
items.gap: I think you ____ me — I said Tuesday, not Thursday.
items.explanation: You took Tuesday as Thursday: **mis**- = wrongly. **Misunderstood**.

items.en: It is illegal to drive on this street.
items.gap: It is ____ to drive on this street.

items.en: The chicken was undercooked, so we put it back in the oven.
items.gap: The chicken was ____, so we put it back in the oven.
items.explanation: Back in the oven: not cooked enough → **under**cooked. **Over**cooked is too much.
items.explanation_cz: Zpět do trouby: málo uvařené → **under**cooked. **Over**cooked je moc.

items.en: She failed the test and was very unhappy about it.
items.gap: She failed the test and was very ____ about it.
items.explanation: She failed — the feeling is the opposite: **un** + happy.

items.en: I think you are wrong — I disagree.
items.gap: I think you are wrong — I ____.
items.explanation: You are wrong → the opposite of agree: **dis**agree.

items.en: It is impossible to finish this today.
items.gap: It is ____ to finish this today.

items.en: Two of the answers are incorrect.
items.gap: Two of the answers are ____.

items.en: Please prepay for the room before you arrive.
items.gap: Please ____ for the room before you arrive.

items.en: She failed the test, so she will retake it on Monday.
items.gap: She failed the test, so she will ____ it on Monday.
items.explanation: She failed → do the test again: **re**take. **Overtake** is pass a car.
items.explanation_cz: Neuspěla → test znovu: **re**take. **Overtake** je předjet auto.

items.en: I always misspell that word.
items.gap: I always ____ that word.
items.explanation: The letters come out wrong: **mis**- = wrongly → **misspell**.

items.en: The lecture was so uninteresting that half the audience fell asleep.
items.gap: The lecture was so ____ that half the audience fell asleep.
items.explanation: The audience fell asleep: not interesting → **un**interesting.

items.en: My glasses always disappear just when I need them.
items.gap: My glasses always ____ just when I need them.
items.explanation: They go: the opposite of appear is **dis**appear.

items.en: Go is an irregular verb — the past form is went.
items.gap: "Go" is an ____ verb — the past form is "went".

items.en: Preheat the oven to 200 degrees before you put the chicken in.
items.gap: ____ the oven to 200 degrees before you put the chicken in.

items.en: Don't be so impatient — the bus will come in a minute.
items.gap: Don't be so ____ — the bus will come in a minute.

items.en: That's unfair — he got two and I got none.
items.gap: That's ____ — he got two and I got none.
items.explanation: He got two, you got none: the opposite of fair is **un**fair.
items.explanation_cz: On dva, ty nic: opak fair je **un**fair.

items.en: This food is terrible. I dislike it.
items.gap: This food is terrible. I ____ it.

items.en: You don't need a jacket — it's informal.
items.gap: You don't need a jacket — it's ____.

items.en: Please replay the last song.
items.gap: Please ____ the last song.

items.en: The chicken is dry because you overcooked it.
items.gap: The chicken is dry because you ____ it.

items.en: He works sixty hours a week and he is still underpaid.
items.gap: He works sixty hours a week and he is still ____.
items.explanation: Long hours and still too little: **under**paid.

items.en: I'm sorry — that was a mistake.
items.gap: I'm sorry — that was a ____.

items.gap: I ____ this morning and missed the train.
items.explanation: ~~underslept~~ — you missed the train, so you slept too much: **over**slept.
